searchText: Discord is getting rid of `#` suffix. This can be great if you want to reduce impersonation, but it's bad if they get your username before you do. Please take some time to register your username under their new system. https://discord.com/blog/usernames They'll roll out in phases so I guess impersonation is bound to happen
